page0.text:
Now is the chance.
It's not just an unexpected intrusion.
Tohsaka and Archer, Caster and Kuzuki. If their powers are equal, then even I can be of help.

page1.text: I can let Archer take care of Caster, so if I can stop Kuzuki even a little, Tohsaka can shoot him from a distance...!

page3.text:
I run down the stairs.
I have Strengthened the bamboo sword in my hand.
I obviously subdued the pain from my wound.
Tohsaka aside, I can't let Caster and the others know that I'm injured.

page4.text:
"Are you serious...!? Why are you here...!?"
"What are you saying? You're the one who said to go to the church.
I didn't think I'd come across such a bad situation either."

page5.text:
Tohsaka bites her tongue in spite of herself.
All right. I said that on a whim, but it seems like I was able to convince Tohsaka more than I expected.

page6.text:
"Anyway, I'm going to help. I should be of use in this situation, right?
...Complain after we defeat Caster."
I cautiously approach Kuzuki so that I can protect Tohsaka.

page7.text: "...You fool. You and Rin would have survived if you had just watched quietly."

page8.text:
"Huh...?"
He mutters to himself, as if he has given up.
Before I realize what that means...
"Caster, this makes three against three. You should have no complaints. Get Saber."

page9.text:
"Wha—"
...Saber's bindings are released.
The blond girl that was crucified falls powerlessly
to the ground, and...

page10.text:
"No way...!? Saber shouldn't be under control yet...!"
"Yes. That is why I used my Command Spell and ordered her to kill you all. That was my command as her Master. I did not want to use it, but I have to, right?"

page11.text:
...Saber stands up.
Her body is covered with silver armor, and in her hands is a golden sword that I've never seen before...

page12.text:
"...Good grief, you got me, boy. Now I only have one Command Spell left. This is for my protection, so I cannot force Saber to do things anymore.
...My plan to make the Holy Grail eternal is now foiled. Now I can only make one wish come true, but..."

page13.text:
"But before that, I shall at least have some fun.
Now, Saber. Show your true powers to these kids who ruined my wish."

page14.text: Saber, holding her golden sword, steps towards us.

page15.text:
"..."
Now that things have come to this, Archer is silent.
Instead of telling Tohsaka to run away, he stands in front of Saber.
That is...
The final act of loyalty from the knight who understands that he can't protect his Master no matter what he does.

page16.text:
Saber and Caster ready their attack.
There's no way to counterattack nor is there time to run away.
How can a mere human defend against it when there is only an instant of life expectancy left, and even Archer has abandoned all hope?
